observations: body (Taurus 8): «so’» is printed so, with an apostrophe.

body (Leo 6): «الملكى» after «pro» is printed with the final yāʾ without dots; in «الملكي» of the Arabic quotation the mīm is not printed (a gap is left) and the dots of yāʾ are printed merged into a stroke; «فاما» and «الكوكب» are printed with elongated joins (kashīda), not transcribed.
body (Leo 6): the i of «igitur» is printed broken (like «!»).
body (Leo 16): the final period is printed raised.
